org.portico.impl

Interface ISpecHelper

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    Impl13Helper, Impl1516eHelper, Impl1516Helper, ImplJava1Helper

    public interface ISpecHelper
    Practically a marker interface to help remove any tight-coupling with the implementations of a specific HLA interface.

    Different HLA interfaces need to hold references to different sets of objects. So that a single LRC can be used with any HLA interface type, each will hold a reference to an ISpecHelper. The implementations of this class can be HLA-interface specific. Any components that use the ISpecHelper will have to cast it to the appropriate type before it is able to use it to extract HLA-interface specific things.
